scope: equations 2B.1 through 2B.78; Lorentzian and Euclidean inversion, superinversion, coordinate generators, graded algebra, Wick continuation, and adjoints

findings.issue: the initial superinversion domain treated y and bar y as independent and did not prove preservation of the superspace constraint
findings.resolution: defined the constrained 4|4 domain and displayed the exact matrix calculation proving bar y prime-y prime=2i vartheta prime sigma barvartheta prime

findings.issue: the initial involution statement omitted the determinant and epsilon contractions
findings.resolution: expanded det Y=-y squared and both two-by-two epsilon contractions before concluding I_s squared=1

findings.issue: the point map and pullback were initially mixed and the K, S, barred S Jacobian table stated results without a typed chain rule
findings.resolution: separated I_s from I_s star, typed chiral-to-antichiral pullback, defined antichiral Q actions, and expanded every even and odd derivative

findings.issue: the fermionic phase was initially composed at the point-map level and lacked its real U(1) domain
findings.resolution: defined I_s_phi star=exp(-i phi R)I_s star for phi in R modulo 2pi and derived K_phi, S_phi, barred S_phi by conjugation

findings.issue: formal integration-by-parts identities were initially written as literal Hilbert-adjoint operator equalities without maximal domains
findings.resolution: replaced them by core sesquilinear identities and explicitly excluded closed or maximal domain claims

findings.issue: the antichiral operators on the right-hand side of the coordinate formal-adjoint equations were undefined
findings.resolution: defined the antichiral D, K, and barred S operators and expanded the shadow-weight calculation Delta prime=3-Delta star

findings.issue: the initial same-weight chiral-antichiral statement omitted the formal-adjoint transformation of the R offset
findings.resolution: expanded R_ch ddagger=2-N_barvartheta+r star and derived r prime=2+r star=2 Delta prime/3

findings.issue: the physical Noether adjoints were asserted without parameter and current reality
findings.resolution: fixed real bosonic parameters, Lorentz spinor reality, current reality, odd order reversal, and unitarity

findings.issue: the initial Euclidean section recorded coordinate phases but omitted the physical Noether phase map and parameter map
findings.resolution: derived physical phases by exponent matching, fixed all parameters, then transferred phases to coordinate generators by diagonal covariance

findings.issue: the initial Euclidean L2 claim acted on full chiral superspace without a Berezin pairing
findings.resolution: restricted to explicit bosonic operators on a compactly supported core and stated only sesquilinear identities

findings.issue: the initial Lorentz audit metadata named an undefined phase label
findings.resolution: regenerated the audit with the explicit plus-minus-i convention of equation 2B.32
